name: Kaya Kimura-Waboose
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Halsted and Division
description:
Kaya Kimura-Waboose is slight and easy to overlook, which is exactly the point. At 28, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would  — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Kaya Kimura-Waboose plans to keep it that way. She works as a fixer out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Kaya Kimura-Waboose lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
psychology.secret: Fanta Kato-Adomako is in augmentation debt to a corporate subsidiary — Φ180,000 outstanding — and the interest is compounding. If they miss a payment, a kill team comes.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Fanta Kato-Adomako's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Fanta Kato-Adomako owes a personal debt to
Fanta Kato-Adomako intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Fanta Kato-Adomako represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would incapacitate. Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora blend with Indigenous American plurality (30.8%) anchoring warm, earth-toned features, complemented by significant South Asian (16.6%), East Asian (14.1%), Hispanic/Latin American (13.6%), and North African (13.6%) ancestry with Sub-Saharan African (11.3%) deepening undertones — resulting in a complex warm bronze complexion with golden and reddish undertones across multiple ancestry groups, creating dimensional warmth throughout the face and body
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry — deceptively fragile-looking, but muscular in the shoulders and forearms from years of fieldwork. Low body fat, efficient frame designed for movement rather than presence.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with subtle dark brown undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid when working; loose shoulder-length when civilian
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle amber undertones
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm earth-bronze with golden-reddish undertones — richly dimensional complexion reflecting the blend of Indigenous American (30.8%), South Asian (16.6%), North African (13.6%), and Sub-Saharan African (11.3%) ancestry, naturally radiant with warm depth throughout
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high, prominent cheekbones and sharp jawline reflecting East Asian and Indigenous American heritage, balanced by warmer pigmentation and slightly broader structure from South Asian and Hispanic ancestry. Skin maintains an even, warm tone with minimal blemishes, though faint lines around the eyes betray irregular sleep and high-stress work. Lips full and often set in neutral expression. Subtle warmth variations across face—golden highlights in cheeks, deeper undertones in hollows—suggesting complex six-way genetic blending across continents.
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel horizontal scars on right inner forearm, white and thin — surgical or deliberate, roughly 8cm each, spaced 2cm apart
Faint burn scar across left shoulder blade, roughly 4cm diameter, slightly raised and lighter than surrounding skin
Small tattoo on right wrist: minimalist geometric pattern (circles intersecting) — 2cm across, black ink, professional work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome pain editor visible at base of skull — a silvered neural interface jack protruding slightly through skin at C7 vertebra, roughly 8mm diameter. Right temple shows the faint subdermal outline of a neural interface module beneath skin. No visible limb replacements or extensive chrome work — augmentations are strategic and minimal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled — she moves with purpose, never wasted motion. Slight forward lean in the shoulders, as if perpetually ready to move. Eyes track exits and sightlines instinctively. In civilian mode, deliberately adopts a more rounded posture and relaxed gait to avoid drawing attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Off-duty: neutral Tier 4 basics — fitted dark grey or black synthetic-weave pants, unmarked hoodies or fitted long-sleeves, minimal branding. Worn work boots with good tread. A grey canvas messenger bag, overstuffed and practical. During contracts: reinforced jacket with internal pockets, tactical harness beneath outer layer, gloves. Everything muted, functional, forgettable.
